text:
lisa: quick ping 9: spotted a 404 from the 'runtime troubleshooting' guide to the 'kv cache' section: /guides/runtime#kvcache -> 404. looks like the heading is 'KV cache' so fragment should be `#kv-cache`.
marco: thanks for the catch. not an owner, but can run a grep across guides + i18n.
lisa: planning a tiny PR to: 1) fix the fragment, 2) add a one-line note about when to enable kv caching, and 3) add a linkcheck unit test. trivial change.
janet: I own runtime troubleshooting. small PRs welcome. open it and tag me; I'll review and merge if CI is green. also prefer the one-liner to include a perf caveat.
doclink-bot: created task docs:linkfix-1723 "runtime troubleshooting kv-cache anchor + note" assigned to @janet, reported by @lisa
lisa: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1347 - includes fragment fix, copy note "Enable KV cache for repeated short prompts; disable for ad-hoc long-context runs to avoid memory pressure.", and linkcheck test.
marco: running grep now across i18n... found same bad fragment in `i18n/pt/guides/runtime.md`. will draft a tiny follow-up PR to update the translated fragment and add translated one-liner.
janet: LGTM on the main fix; left one micro nit about wording (suggest 'short repeated prompts' vs 'repeated short prompts'). i'll take that in a follow-up commit and merge after CI. thanks for the quick PR, @lisa :raised_hands:
lisa: thanks all! marco, appreciate the i18n follow-up. i'll queue a small checklist in the PR description so reviewers know to watch translations.
